name: Air quality
description: Yearly mean air pollution against the WHO guideline: nitrogen dioxide, coarse or fine particulate matter.

variants.name: NO₂
variants.title: Air quality, NO₂
variants.description: Yearly mean nitrogen dioxide, mostly from traffic, against the WHO guideline.

classify.title: Nitrogen dioxide (NO₂)
classify.note: Annual mean in µg/m³. WHO guideline 10, EU limit 40 (20 from 2030). RIVM, {year}.

variants.name: PM10
variants.title: Air quality, PM10
variants.description: Yearly mean coarse particulate matter, against the WHO guideline.

classify.title: Particulate matter (PM10)
classify.note: Annual mean in µg/m³. WHO guideline 15, EU limit 40 (20 from 2030). RIVM, {year}.

variants.name: PM2.5
variants.title: Air quality, PM2.5
variants.description: Yearly mean fine particulate matter, the most harmful to health, against the WHO guideline.

classify.title: Fine particulate matter (PM2.5)
classify.note: Annual mean in µg/m³. WHO guideline 5, EU limit 25 (10 from 2030). RIVM, {year}.
